text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- King Hussein, in phone conversation with Palestinian President Arafat, stresses unwavering Jordanian support.
- Head of prime minister's special office goes to Kuwait on official visit.
- Israeli President Weizman visits Jordan on Wednesday to discuss Middle East peace process.
- Central Bank wants to deregulate foreign exchange dealings.
- Jordan and Algeria sign protocol to increase exports of pharmaceuticals.
- Study to grant administrative independence to state-run television and radio corporation.
- Palestinian president opens first exhibition of Jordanian industries in West Bank town of Ramallah.
- King Hussein confers on phone with Arafat, discusses redeployment in Hebron.
- King meets senior PLO official Abu Mazen and stresses support of Palestinians and need to implement peace accords.
- Finance Minister Awad and Central Bank Governor Fariz discuss financial policy with finance committee of parliament; Awad says 1997 budget has not been completed.
- Government targets reducing deficit and debt servicing in 1997 fiscal budget.
- Jordanian envoy meets Kuwaiti Foreign Minister Sheikh Sabah al Ahmad.
- Israeli President Weizman's visit to Jordan will help bilateral relations and peace process, says Israeli ambassador.
- Jordan, U.S. end joint military exercises.
